statements.sql: WITH seq AS (SELECT json_get_str(e.properties, '$group_team') AS person, e.ts AS ts, e.event_id AS event_id, CASE WHEN (e.name = 'A') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS m1, CASE WHEN (e.name = 'B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS m2, CASE WHEN (e.name = 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS m3 FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND json_get_str(e.properties, '$group_team') IS NOT NULL AND ((e.name = 'A') OR (e.name = 'B') OR (e.name = 'C'))), a AS (SELECT person, MIN(ts) AS t0, '' AS bd FROM seq GROUP BY person), p AS (SELECT q.person AS person, MIN(a.t0) AS t0, MIN(a.bd) AS bd, MAX(q.m1) AS d1, MIN(CASE WHEN q.m1 = 1 THEN q.ts END) AS f1, MAX(q.m2) AS d2, MIN(CASE WHEN q.m2 = 1 THEN q.ts END) AS f2, MAX(q.m3) AS d3, MIN(CASE WHEN q.m3 = 1 THEN q.ts END) AS f3 FROM seq q JOIN a ON a.person = q.person WHERE q.ts <= a.t0 + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY q.person), r1 AS (SELECT person, t0 AS t1, f1 AS t, t0 AS tp, bd FROM p WHERE d1 = 1), r2 AS (SELECT person, t0 AS t1, f2 AS t, t0 AS tp, bd FROM p WHERE d1 = 1 AND d2 = 1), r3 AS (SELECT person, t0 AS t1, f3 AS t, t0 AS tp, bd FROM p WHERE d1 = 1 AND d2 = 1 AND d3 = 1) SELECT 1 AS step, bd AS bd, COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS persons, AVG(to_unixtime(t) - to_unixtime(tp)) AS avg_secs FROM r1 GROUP BY bd UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS step, bd AS bd, COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS persons, AVG(to_unixtime(t) - to_unixtime(tp)) AS avg_secs FROM r2 GROUP BY bd UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS step, bd AS bd, COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS persons, AVG(to_unixtime(t) - bd FROM s4 s LEFT JOIN xall xa ON xa.person = s.person WHERE xa.person IS NULL) SELECT 1 AS step, bd AS bd, COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS persons, AVG(to_unixtime(t) - to_unixtime(tp)) AS avg_secs FROM r1 to_unixtime(tp)) AS avg_secs FROM r4 GROUP BY bd

e.utm_source AS c_utm_source, e.referrer_host AS c_referrer_host, CASE WHEN (e.name = 'A') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS m1, CASE WHEN (e.name = 'B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS m2 FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND ((e.name = 'A') OR (e.name = 'B'))), s1 AS (SELECT person, MIN(ts) AS t1, MIN(ts) AS t, MIN(ts) AS tp, '' AS bd, FIRST_VALUE(c_country ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS c_country, FIRST_VALUE(c_device_type ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS c_device_type, FIRST_VALUE(c_browser ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS c_browser, FIRST_VALUE(c_os ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS c_os, FIRST_VALUE(c_utm_source ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS c_utm_source, FIRST_VALUE(c_referrer_host ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS c_referrer_host FROM seq WHERE m1 = 1 GROUP BY person), s2 AS (SELECT p.person AS person, p.t1 AS t1, p.t AS tp, MIN(q.ts) AS t, MIN(p.bd) AS bd FROM s1 p JOIN seq q ON q.person = p.person WHERE q.m2 = 1 AND q.ts >= p.t AND q.ts <= p.t1 + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY p.person, p.t1, p.t), o AS (SELECT a.person AS person, MIN(a.t1) AS t1, MAX(CASE WHEN b.person IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS conv, MAX(COALESCE(b.t, a.t1 + INTERVAL '7 days')) AS t_end, MIN(a.c_country) AS c_country, MIN(a.c_device_type) AS c_device_type, MIN(a.c_browser) AS c_browser, MIN(a.c_os) AS c_os, MIN(a.c_utm_source) AS c_utm_source, MIN(a.c_referrer_host) AS c_referrer_host FROM s1 a LEFT JOIN s2 b ON b.person = a.person AND b.t1 = a.t1 GROUP BY a.person) SELECT e.name AS value, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.conv = 1 THEN o.person END) AS success, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.conv = 0 THEN o.person END) AS failure FROM panel.events_v1 e JOIN o ON o.person = e.distinct_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.ts >= o.t1 AND e.ts <= o.t_end AND e.name NOT IN ('A', 'B', '$pageleave', '$identify', '$webvitals', '$autocapture') GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.person) DESC LIMIT 200

AS bd FROM s1 p JOIN seq q ON q.person = p.person WHERE q.m2 = 1 AND q.ts >= p.t AND q.ts <= p.t1 + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY p.person, p.t1, p.t), o AS (SELECT a.person AS person, MIN(a.t1) AS t1, MAX(CASE WHEN b.person IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS conv, MAX(COALESCE(b.t, a.t1 + INTERVAL '7 days')) AS t_end, MIN(a.c_country) AS c_country, MIN(a.c_device_type) AS c_device_type, MIN(a.c_browser) AS c_browser, MIN(a.c_os) AS c_os, MIN(a.c_utm_source) AS c_utm_source, MIN(a.c_referrer_host) AS c_referrer_host FROM s1 a LEFT JOIN s2 b ON b.person = a.person AND b.t1 = a.t1 GROUP BY a.person), k AS (SELECT '$total' AS prop UNION ALL SELECT 'country' AS prop UNION ALL SELECT 'device_type' AS prop UNION ALL SELECT 'browser' AS prop UNION ALL SELECT 'os' AS prop UNION ALL SELECT 'utm_source' AS prop UNION ALL SELECT 'referrer_host' AS prop) SELECT k.prop AS prop, CASE k.prop WHEN 'country' THEN COALESCE(CAST(o.c_country AS VARCHAR), '(none)') WHEN 'device_type' THEN COALESCE(CAST(o.c_device_type AS VARCHAR), '(none)') WHEN 'browser' THEN COALESCE(CAST(o.c_browser AS VARCHAR), '(none)') WHEN 'os' THEN COALESCE(CAST(o.c_os AS VARCHAR), '(none)') WHEN 'utm_source' '(none)') WHEN 'browser' THEN COALESCE(CAST(o.c_browser AS VARCHAR), '(none)') WHEN 'os' THEN COALESCE(CAST(o.c_os AS VARCHAR), '(none)') WHEN 'utm_source' THEN COALESCE(CAST(o.c_utm_source AS statements.name: impact.groups
statements.sql: SELECT adopted, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(mb) AS mb, SUM(ma) AS ma, SUM(ub) AS ub, SUM(ua) AS ua, SUM(cb) AS cb, SUM(ca) AS ca, SUM(active_after) AS active_after FROM (SELECT e.distinct_id AS u, MAX(CASE WHEN e.name = 'Used AI' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adopted, SUM(CASE WHEN e.name = 'Purchase' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' > e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mb, SUM(CASE WHEN e.name = 'Purchase' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ma, MAX(CASE WHEN e.name = 'Purchase' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' > e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ub, MAX(CASE WHEN e.name = 'Purchase' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ua, SUM(CASE WHEN e.name = 'Purchase' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' > e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cb, SUM(CASE WHEN e.name = 'Purchase' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ca, MAX(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_after FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-25 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-08 00:00:00' GROUP BY e.distinct_id) AS per GROUP BY adopted

statements.name: impact.groups
statements.sql: SELECT adopted, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(mb) AS mb, SUM(ma) AS ma, SUM(ub) AS ub, SUM(ua) AS ua, SUM(cb) AS cb, SUM(ca) AS ca, SUM(active_after) AS active_after FROM (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS u, MAX(CASE WHEN ((e.name = 'Signed up' AND (((json_get_float(e.properties, 'price')) * (json_get_float(e.properties, 'quantity'))) > 0)) OR (e.name = '$pageview' AND (e.path = '/welcome'''))) AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adopted, SUM(CASE WHEN ((e.name = 'Checkout') OR (e.name = 'Purchase' AND (json_contains(g_company.properties, 'plan')) AND (json_get_str(pp.properties, 'plan') = 'pro'))) AND (e.country = 'NL') AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' > e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mb, SUM(CASE WHEN ((e.name = 'Checkout') OR (e.name = 'Purchase' AND (json_contains(g_company.properties, 'plan')) AND (json_get_str(pp.properties, 'plan') = 'pro'))) AND (e.country = 'NL') AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ma, MAX(CASE WHEN ((e.name = 'Checkout') OR (e.name = 'Purchase' AND (json_contains(g_company.properties, 'plan')) AND (json_get_str(pp.properties, 'plan') = 'pro'))) AND (e.country = 'NL') AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' > e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ub, MAX(CASE WHEN ((e.name = 'Checkout') OR (e.name = 'Purchase' AND (json_contains(g_company.properties, 'plan')) AND (json_get_str(pp.properties, 'plan') = 'pro'))) AND (e.country = 'NL') AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ua, SUM(CASE WHEN ((e.name = 'Checkout') OR (e.name = 'Purchase' AND (json_contains(g_company.properties, 'plan')) AND (json_get_str(pp.properties, 'plan') = 'pro'))) AND (e.country = 'NL') AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' > e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cb, SUM(CASE WHEN ((e.name = 'Checkout') OR (e.name = 'Purchase' AND (json_contains(g_company.properties, 'plan')) AND (json_get_str(pp.properties, 'plan') = 'pro'))) AND (e.country = 'NL') AND TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ca, MAX(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' <= e.ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_after FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) pp ON pp.user_id = COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_key, properties FROM (SELECT group_key, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_key ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.groups_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND group_type = 'company') AS gl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) g_company ON g_company.group_key = json_get_str(e.properties, '$group_company') WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-25 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-08 00:00:00' AND (e.country IN ('NL', 'BE')) AND (json_get_str(e.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND (LOWER(json_get_str(pp.properties, '$email')) LIKE '%@example.com%' ESCAPE '!') AND (COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) IN (SELECT pl2.user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) AS pl2 WHERE json_get_str(pl2.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) IN (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Signed up' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) AND COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) NOT IN (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Upgraded' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1)) GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) AS per GROUP BY adopted

AND (e.distinct_id IN (SELECT pl2.user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) AS pl2 WHERE json_get_str(pl2.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND e.distinct_id IN (SELECT e.distinct_id FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Signed up' GROUP BY e.distinct_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) AND e.distinct_id NOT IN (SELECT e.distinct_id FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Upgraded' GROUP BY e.distinct_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1)) AND ((e.name = 'Signed up' AND (((json_get_float(e.properties, 'price')) * (json_get_float(e.properties, 'quantity'))) > 0)) OR (e.name = '$pageview' AND (e.path = '/welcome'''))) GROUP BY COALESCE(json_get_str(g_company.properties, 'plan'), '(none)') ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.distinct_id) DESC LIMIT 10

statements.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT e.distinct_id AS person, MIN(e.ts) AS t0 FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) pp ON pp.user_id = e.distinct_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-17 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND (e.country IN ('NL', 'BE')) AND (json_get_str(e.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND (LOWER(json_get_str(pp.properties, '$email')) LIKE '%@example.com%' ESCAPE '!') AND (e.distinct_id IN (SELECT pl2.user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) AS pl2 WHERE json_get_str(pl2.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND e.distinct_id IN (SELECT e.distinct_id FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Signed up' GROUP BY e.distinct_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) AND e.distinct_id NOT IN (SELECT e.distinct_id FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Upgraded' GROUP BY e.distinct_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1)) AND e.name = 'Signed up' GROUP BY e.distinct_id) SELECT date_trunc('week', t0) AS cohort, COUNT(*) AS size FROM f GROUP BY date_trunc('week', t0) ORDER BY date_trunc('week', t0) ASC

('^/blog/([a-z-]+)/' || chr(92) || 'd+$'), '/blog/$1/:n', 'g') AS VARCHAR), '(none)')) AS value, COALESCE(json_get_str(g_company.properties, 'plan'), '(none)') AS v0, CASE WHEN json_get_float(e.properties, 'amount') < 750 THEN '500 – 750' ELSE '≥ 750' END AS v1, COALESCE(CAST(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(e.path, ('^/users/' || chr(92) || 'd+'), '/users/:id', anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= AND (COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) IN (SELECT pl2.user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) AS pl2 WHERE json_get_str(pl2.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) IN (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Signed up' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) AND COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) NOT IN (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Upgraded' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1)) AND e.name IN ('$pageview', 'Purchase') GROUP BY COALESCE(json_get_str(pp.properties, 'plan'), '(none)') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

statements.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(e.path, ('^/users/' || chr(92) || 'd+'), '/users/:id', 'g'), '/o''rders/[0-9]+', '/orders/:id', 'g'), ('^/blog/([a-z-]+)/' || chr(92) || 'd+$'), '/blog/$1/:n', 'g') AS path, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = '$pageview'), seg AS (SELECT path, session_id, anon_id, ts, event_id, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM pv), ranked AS (SELECT path, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn_last FROM seg) SELECT path, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exits FROM ranked GROUP BY path ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 20

statements.name: web.channels
statements.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND NOT ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Paid Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('paid-social', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'social-paid', 'social_paid', 'cpm-social') OR (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Paid Social' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'expandable', 'interstitial') THEN 'Display' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliate' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter')) THEN 'Email' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'video' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtube.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtube.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitch.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitch.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!' statements.name: web.screenSizes
statements.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN e.viewport_w IS NULL OR e.viewport_w <= 0 THEN '(unknown)' WHEN e.viewport_w < 768 THEN 'mobile' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1024 THEN 'tablet' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1440 THEN 'laptop' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1920 THEN 'desktop' ELSE 'wide' END AS value, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS events FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = '$pageview' GROUP BY CASE WHEN e.viewport_w IS NULL OR e.viewport_w <= 0 THEN '(unknown)' WHEN e.viewport_w < 768 THEN 'mobile' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1024 THEN 'tablet' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1440 THEN 'laptop' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1920 THEN 'desktop' ELSE 'wide' END ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

statements.name: web.summary
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.distinct_id AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

statements.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT e.path AS path, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = '$pageview'), seg AS (SELECT path, session_id, anon_id, ts, event_id, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM pv), ranked AS (SELECT path, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn_last FROM seg) SELECT path, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exits FROM ranked GROUP BY path ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 20

statements.name: web.summary
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Paid Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('paid-social', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'social-paid', 'social_paid', 'cpm-social') OR (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Paid Social' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'expandable', 'interstitial') THEN 'Display' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliate' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter')) THEN 'Email' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'video' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtube.%' ESCAPE '!' THEN 'Video' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'organic' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bing.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bing.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!' THEN 'Organic Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' statements.name: web.summary.previous
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-16 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) statements.name: web.summary
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - statements.name: web.screenSizes
statements.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN e.viewport_w IS NULL OR e.viewport_w <= 0 THEN '(unknown)' WHEN e.viewport_w < 768 THEN 'mobile' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1024 THEN 'tablet' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1440 THEN 'laptop' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1920 THEN 'desktop' ELSE 'wide' END AS value, COUNT(DISTINCT e.distinct_id) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS events FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_key, properties FROM (SELECT group_key, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_key ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.groups_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND group_type = 'company') AS gl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) g_company ON g_company.group_key = json_get_str(e.properties, '$group_company') WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND (json_get_str(g_company.properties, 'plan') = 'enterprise') AND e.name = '$pageview' GROUP BY CASE WHEN e.viewport_w IS NULL OR e.viewport_w <= 0 THEN '(unknown)' WHEN e.viewport_w < 768 THEN 'mobile' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1024 THEN 'tablet' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1440 THEN 'laptop' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1920 THEN 'desktop' ELSE 'wide' END ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.distinct_id) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND user_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND anon_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe'))) AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_key, properties FROM (SELECT group_key, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_key ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.groups_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND group_type = 'company') AS gl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) g_company ON g_company.group_key = json_get_str(e.properties, '$group_company') WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.anon_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND e.distinct_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND COALESCE(e.user_id, '') NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND (json_get_str(g_company.properties, 'plan') = 'enterprise')), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn_last FROM seg) SELECT path, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LIMIT 20

statements.name: web.channels
statements.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND NOT ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Paid Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('paid-social', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'social-paid', 'social_paid', 'cpm-social') OR (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Paid Social' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'expandable', 'interstitial') THEN 'Display' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliate' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter')) THEN 'Email' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'video' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtube.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtube.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitch.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitch.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Video' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'organic' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bing.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bing.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'baidu.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.baidu.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yandex.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yandex.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!') statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_key, properties FROM (SELECT group_key, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_key ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.groups_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND group_type = 'company') AS gl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) g_company ON g_company.group_key = json_get_str(e.properties, '$group_company') WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND (json_get_str(g_company.properties, 'plan') = 'enterprise')), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Paid Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('paid-social', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'social-paid', 'social_paid', 'cpm-social') OR (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Paid Social' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'expandable', 'interstitial') THEN 'Display' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliate' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter')) THEN 'Email' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'video' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtube.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtube.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitch.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitch.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Video' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'organic' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bing.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bing.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'baidu.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.baidu.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yandex.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yandex.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'startpage.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.startpage.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'qwant.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.qwant.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Organic Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Organic Social' WHEN ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'outlook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.outlook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'webmail.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.webmail.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Email' WHEN (NOT (e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND e.utm_source IS NULL AND e.utm_medium IS NULL AND e.utm_campaign IS NULL) THEN 'Direct' WHEN ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'referral') THEN 'Referral' ELSE 'Other' END ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

statements.name: web.screenSizes
statements.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN e.viewport_w IS NULL OR e.viewport_w <= 0 THEN '(unknown)' WHEN e.viewport_w < 768 THEN 'mobile' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1024 THEN 'tablet' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1440 THEN 'laptop' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1920 THEN 'desktop' ELSE 'wide' END AS value, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS events FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_key, properties FROM (SELECT group_key, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_key ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.groups_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND group_type = 'company') AS gl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) g_company ON g_company.group_key = json_get_str(e.properties, '$group_company') WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND (json_get_str(g_company.properties, 'plan') = 'enterprise') AND e.name = '$pageview' GROUP BY CASE WHEN e.viewport_w IS NULL OR e.viewport_w <= 0 THEN '(unknown)' WHEN e.viewport_w < 768 THEN 'mobile' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1024 THEN 'tablet' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1440 THEN 'laptop' WHEN e.viewport_w < 1920 THEN 'desktop' ELSE 'wide' END ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

statements.name: web.goals
statements.sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN (((e.name = 'Signed up' AND (((json_get_float(e.properties, 'price')) * (json_get_float(e.properties, 'quantity'))) > 0)) OR (e.name = '$pageview' AND (e.path = '/welcome''')))) THEN 1 END) AS g0_n, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (((e.name = 'Signed up' AND (((json_get_float(e.properties, 'price')) * (json_get_float(e.properties, 'quantity'))) > 0)) OR (e.name = '$pageview' AND (e.path = '/welcome''')))) THEN COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) END) AS g0_u, COUNT(CASE WHEN (e.name = '$pageview' AND (json_contains(pp.properties, 'plan')) AND e.path LIKE '/pricing%' ESCAPE '!') THEN 1 END) AS g1_n, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (e.name = '$pageview' AND (json_contains(pp.properties, 'plan')) AND e.path LIKE '/pricing%' ESCAPE '!') THEN COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) END) AS g1_u FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) pp ON pp.user_id = COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_key, properties FROM (SELECT group_key, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_key ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.groups_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND group_type = 'company') AS gl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) g_company ON g_company.group_key = json_get_str(e.properties, '$group_company') WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND (json_get_str(g_company.properties, 'plan') = 'enterprise') AND ((((e.name = 'Signed up' AND (((json_get_float(e.properties, 'price')) * (json_get_float(e.properties, 'quantity'))) > 0)) OR (e.name = '$pageview' AND (e.path = '/welcome''')))) OR (e.name = '$pageview' AND (json_contains(pp.properties, 'plan')) AND e.path LIKE '/pricing%' ESCAPE '!'))

statements.name: web.summary
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.distinct_id AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

statements.name: web.entryExit
statements.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(e.path, ('^/users/' || chr(92) || 'd+'), '/users/:id', 'g'), '/o''rders/[0-9]+', '/orders/:id', 'g'), ('^/blog/([a-z-]+)/' || chr(92) || 'd+$'), '/blog/$1/:n', 'g') AS path, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = '$pageview'), seg AS (SELECT path, session_id, anon_id, ts, event_id, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM pv), ranked AS (SELECT path, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn_last FROM seg) SELECT path, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exits FROM ranked GROUP BY path ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 20

statements.name: web.summary
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND user_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND anon_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe'))) AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.anon_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND e.distinct_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND COALESCE(e.user_id, '') NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe'))), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

statements.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(e.path, ('^/users/' || chr(92) || 'd+'), '/users/:id', 'g'), '/o''rders/[0-9]+', '/orders/:id', 'g'), ('^/blog/([a-z-]+)/' || chr(92) || 'd+$'), '/blog/$1/:n', 'g') AS path, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND user_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND anon_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe'))) AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.anon_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND e.distinct_id NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND COALESCE(e.user_id, '') NOT IN ('user_gone', 'anon''_gone', ('CORP' || chr(92) || 'jdoe')) AND e.name = '$pageview'), seg AS (SELECT path, session_id, anon_id, ts, event_id, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM pv), ranked AS (SELECT path, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn_last FROM seg) SELECT path, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exits FROM ranked GROUP BY path ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 20

OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Paid Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('paid-social', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'social-paid', 'social_paid', 'cpm-social') OR (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Paid Social' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'expandable', 'interstitial') THEN 'Display' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliate' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter')) THEN 'Email' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'video' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtube.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtube.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitch.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitch.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!')))) statements.name: web.summary
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

statements.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(e.path, ('^/users/' || chr(92) || 'd+'), '/users/:id', 'g'), '/o''rders/[0-9]+', '/orders/:id', 'g'), ('^/blog/([a-z-]+)/' || chr(92) || 'd+$'), '/blog/$1/:n', 'g') AS path, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = '$pageview'), seg AS (SELECT path, session_id, anon_id, ts, event_id, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM pv), ranked AS (SELECT path, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn_last FROM seg) SELECT path, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exits FROM ranked GROUP BY path ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 20
