THEN 'Video' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'organic' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bing.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bing.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'baidu.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.baidu.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yandex.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yandex.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'startpage.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.startpage.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'qwant.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.qwant.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Organic Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Organic Social' WHEN ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'outlook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.outlook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'webmail.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.webmail.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Email' WHEN (NOT (e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND e.utm_source IS NULL AND e.utm_medium IS NULL AND e.utm_campaign IS NULL) THEN 'Direct' WHEN ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'referral') THEN 'Referral' ELSE 'Other' END ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.distinct_id AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) pp ON pp.user_id = e.distinct_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND (e.country IN ('NL', 'BE')) AND (json_get_str(e.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND (LOWER(json_get_str(pp.properties, '$email')) LIKE '%@example.com%' ESCAPE '!') AND (e.distinct_id IN (SELECT pl2.user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) AS pl2 WHERE json_get_str(pl2.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND e.distinct_id IN (SELECT e.distinct_id FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Signed up' GROUP BY e.distinct_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) AND e.distinct_id NOT IN (SELECT e.distinct_id FROM panel.events_v1 e WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Upgraded' GROUP BY e.distinct_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1))), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Paid Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('paid-social', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'social-paid', 'social_paid', 'cpm-social') OR (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Paid Social' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'expandable', 'interstitial') THEN 'Display' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliate' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter')) THEN 'Email' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'video' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtube.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtube.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitch.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitch.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Video' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'organic' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bing.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bing.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'baidu.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.baidu.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yandex.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yandex.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'startpage.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.startpage.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'qwant.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.qwant.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Organic Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Organic Social' WHEN ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'outlook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.outlook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'webmail.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Paid Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('paid-social', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'social-paid', 'social_paid', 'cpm-social') OR (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Paid Social' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'expandable', 'interstitial') THEN 'Display' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliate' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter')) THEN 'Email' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'video' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtube.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtube.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitch.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitch.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Video' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'organic' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bing.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bing.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!' AND (COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) IN (SELECT pl2.user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) AS pl2 WHERE json_get_str(pl2.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) IN (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Signed up' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) AND COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) NOT IN (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Upgraded' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1)) AND e.name = '$pageview' GROUP BY COALESCE(e.device_type, '(unknown)') ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

statements.name: web.channels
statements.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND NOT ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Paid Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('paid-social', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'social-paid', 'social_paid', 'cpm-social') OR (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paidsearch', 'paid-search', 'paid_search', 'sem') AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Paid Social' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'expandable', 'interstitial') THEN 'Display' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliate' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter')) THEN 'Email' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'video' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtube.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtube.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.youtu.be%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.vimeo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitch.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitch.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.dailymotion.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Video' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'organic' OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bing.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bing.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.duckduckgo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'baidu.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.baidu.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'yandex.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.yandex.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.ecosia.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.search.brave.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'startpage.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.startpage.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'qwant.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.qwant.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Organic Search' WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') OR ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'facebook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.facebook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'instagram.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.instagram.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 't.co%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.t.co%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'twitter.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.twitter.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'x.com%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.x.com%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.linkedin.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.lnkd.in%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'reddit.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.reddit.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.pinterest.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.tiktok.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'threads.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.threads.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mastodon.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'bsky.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.bsky.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.news.ycombinator.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'quora.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.quora.%' ESCAPE '!')))) THEN 'Organic Social' WHEN ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND ((e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.google.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.google.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'outlook.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.outlook.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.yahoo.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'webmail.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.webmail.%' ESCAPE '!') OR (e.referrer_host LIKE 'mail.%' ESCAPE '!' OR e.referrer_host LIKE '%.mail.%' ESCAPE '!'))) THEN 'Email' WHEN (NOT (e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) AND e.utm_source IS NULL AND e.utm_medium IS NULL AND e.utm_campaign IS NULL) THEN 'Direct' WHEN ((e.referrer_host IS NOT NULL AND e.referrer_host <> '' AND (e.host IS NULL OR e.referrer_host <> e.host)) OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.utm_medium, '')) = 'referral') THEN 'Referral' ELSE 'Other' END AS value, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id)) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS events FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) pp ON pp.user_id = COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND (e.country IN ('NL', 'BE')) AND (json_get_str(e.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND (LOWER(json_get_str(pp.properties, '$email')) LIKE '%@example.com%' ESCAPE '!') statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) pp ON pp.user_id = COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-16 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00' AND (e.country IN ('NL', 'BE')) AND (json_get_str(e.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND (LOWER(json_get_str(pp.properties, '$email')) LIKE '%@example.com%' ESCAPE '!') AND (COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) IN (SELECT pl2.user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, properties FROM (SELECT user_id, properties, deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn FROM panel.people_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS pl WHERE rn = 1 AND deleted = false) AS pl2 WHERE json_get_str(pl2.properties, 'plan') = 'pro') AND COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) IN (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Signed up' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) AND COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) NOT IN (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 12:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = 'Upgraded' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1))), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

statements.name: web.summary
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-31 23:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit

statements.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT e.path AS path, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-31 23:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00' AND e.name = '$pageview'), seg AS (SELECT path, session_id, anon_id, ts, event_id, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM pv), ranked AS (SELECT path, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts ASC, event_id ASC) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no ORDER BY ts DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn_last FROM seg) SELECT path, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exits FROM ranked GROUP BY path ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 20

statements.name: web.summary
statements.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.user_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.session_id AS session_id, e.anon_id AS anon_id, e.ts AS ts, e.name AS name, e.event_id AS event_id, LAG(e.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(e.session_id, e.anon_id) ORDER BY e.ts, e.event_id) AS prev_ts FROM panel.events_v1 e LEFT JOIN (SELECT anon_id, user_id FROM (SELECT anon_id, user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY anon_id ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM panel.identities_v1 WHERE workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND project_id = 'pnp_1' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-14 12:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00') AS il WHERE rn = 1) i ON i.anon_id = e.anon_id WHERE e.workspace_id = 'ws_1' AND e.project_id = 'pnp_1' AND e.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 00:00:00' AND e.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-14 12:00:00'), seg AS (SELECT person, session_id, anon_id, ts, name, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR to_unixtime(ts) - to_unixtime(prev_ts) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) ORDER BY ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_no FROM ev), visit AS (SELECT COALESCE(session_id, anon_id) AS visit_key, seg_no, MIN(person) AS person, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actions FROM seg GROUP BY COALESCE(session_id, anon_id), seg_no) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pageviews <= 1 AND actions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, SUM(to_unixtime(t1) - to_unixtime(t0)) AS duration_seconds FROM visit
